id: title:andehen:skip follow up work when an experiment save fails

review.posthog_relevance: Adds typed status handling and cached-result preservation to experiment configuration updates, preventing loss of cached data on failure and allowing callers to await completion.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F4 demonstrates a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement. P1.F4.H2 and P1.F4.H3 replace a boolean status check with a typed status ('saved' | 'failed' | 'conflict') and explicitly preserve cached results only on successful saves, preventing data loss. P1.F3.H6 adds a test for accumulated excluded variants, supporting the configuration behavior. P1
review.uncertainty: The chunk P1.F1 is explicitly identified as a test-only change with no production implementation, so it does not contribute to the score. P1.F4.H10 provides a caller-friendly API, but its implementation and dependent usage are not shown, so its benefit is not demonstrated. The score relies on P1.F4, which shows clear implementation and checks.

observations.behavior: Adds a new test asserting that excluded_variants are accumulated correctly when multiple variants are excluded while an unsaved update is pending.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the experiment client correctly batches exclusion state before sending an update, relevant to experiment configuration and variant exclusion behavior.

observations.behavior: Refactors the save status check: the helper now returns a typed status ('saved' | 'failed' | 'conflict') instead of a boolean, and callers use this status to decide whether to proceed or clear cached results.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the experiment configuration actions to distinguish between a successful save and a failure, and to avoid clearing cached results after a failed save, preserving the previous experiment state.

observations.behavior: Replaces the inline try/catch and status-less save with a call to the typed helper, and clears cached results only on successful save; also preserves the previous experiment and its results after a failed save.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the metric results clearing behavior: cached results are cleared only after a successful save, while a failed save preserves the previous experiment and its results, preventing loss of cached data.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exported async function saveExperimentUpdate that instantiates the experimentLogic, dispatches an update action, and returns the result of an awaited helper inflightUpdateSaved.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a caller-friendly API to await the completion and result of an experiment update, rather than relying on the internal asyncActions or the loader's error reporting.
